title: asperula purpurea subsp. apuana
intro: Asperula purpurea subsp. apuana, commonly known as Apuan Woodruff, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Rubiaceae. It is an herb used in traditional medicine, valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Apuan Woodruff are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including iridoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which may help to soothe digestive issues, reduce stress, and promote wound healing. However, more research is needed to fully understand the effects of Apuan Woodruff on human health, and it should be used under the guidance of a healthcare professional.
